newsitem.title: USA: Exploration Co gets credit line.
newsitem.headline: Exploration Co gets credit line.

text.p: The Exploration Co said on Friday it has arranged a $1 million credit line to cover its share of drilling costs for four wells.
The wells are in the Red River formation of the Williston Basin as well as on its leasehold in South Texas, the company said.
The credit line has been provided by a major Swiss bank at a floating rate of interest, which is currently 6.5 percent, Exploration Co said.

The company had recently acquired a 25 percent stake in the horizontal Red River trend in portions of North Dakota and Montana, Exploration Co said. The company is applying for permits to drill ten wells in the trend, it said.
